title: Strictly Come Dancing couple James and Ola Jordan announce marriage split
summary: James and Ola Jordan, a couple known for their long tenure on the show Strictly Come Dancing, have announced their separation after nearly 23 years of marriage. The announcement comes after a period described as 'incredibly painful' for the couple. Reports indicate they are 'not in a good place' following the split.
summary_points: James and Ola Jordan, a couple from Strictly Come Dancing, have announced their separation.
They were married for almost 23 years.
The period leading up to the split has been described as 'incredibly painful'.
Reports state the couple is 'not in a good place'.

summary_hi: 'स्ट्रिक्टली कम डांसिंग' के अपने लंबे कार्यकाल के लिए जाने जाने वाले जोड़े जेम्स और ओला जॉर्डन ने लगभग 23 साल की शादी के बाद अपने अलगाव की घोषणा की है। यह घोषणा एक ऐसे दौर के बाद आई है जिसे जोड़े के लिए 'अविश्वसनीय रूप से दर्दनाक' बताया गया है। रिपोर्टों से संकेत मिलता है कि अलगाव के बाद वे 'अच्छी स्थिति में नहीं हैं'।
